entrance.name: entrance
entrance.description: An old trail choked with weeds. The air smells of fresh earth and cut grass.

village_square.name: Village Square
village_square.description: A peaceful square paved with moss-covered stones. An old fountain trickles softly at its center.

abandoned_farm.name: Abandoned Farm
abandoned_farm.description: A barren patch of land surrounded by broken fences. A menacing crow watches you from a fence post.

merchant_tent.name: Merchant's Tent
merchant_tent.description: A colorful canvas sheltering all sorts of tools and seeds. It smells of incense and old parchment.

turnip_seed.name: Turnip Seed
turnip_seed.description: A small, promising seed. Ideal for starting a crop.

crisp_apple.name: Crisp Apple
crisp_apple.description: A ripe red apple fallen from a nearby tree. Restores a bit of health.

leather_boots.name: Leather Boots
leather_boots.description: Old farmer's boots. They give you more confidence and a slight shield.

gold_acorn.name: Gold Acorn
gold_acorn.description: The local currency. Gleams with a magical shine.

rusty_hoe.name: Rusty Hoe
rusty_hoe.description: An old farming tool. Not great for tilling, but it can serve as a makeshift weapon.

pitchfork.name: Farmer's Pitchfork
pitchfork.description: A sturdy pitchfork with iron prongs. Perfect for fending off pests.

farmer_fiona.name: Farmer Fiona
farmer_fiona.description: An energetic young woman desperately looking for something to plant.
dialogue: Oh, hello! Spring is here but I have nothing left to plant...
If you find me a Turnip Seed, I'll reward you generously!

angry_crow.name: Angry Crow
angry_crow.description: A large, highly territorial black bird defending the abandoned field.

merchant_milo.name: Merchant Milo
merchant_milo.description: A smiling traveler, always ready to make a deal.
dialogue: Welcome! Take a look at my wares, everything's fresh and guaranteed magic-free!

spring_harvest.description: Find a Turnip Seed on the Overgrown Path and bring it to Fiona.

scare_the_crow.description: Defeat the Angry Crow at the Abandoned Farm to secure the fields.
